job.job_description:
Position GEN AI Engineer
Experience 3 to 5 Years

Location – Kolkata/ Indore/ Pune


Gen AI Development ,Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Langchain, Llamaindex, Vector Databases, Multimodal LLMs, Langsmith, Arize Phoenix, RAGAs, LLM-as-a-Judge, Flask, FastAPI, MCP.

AI Engineer (Gen AI) 3-5 years of experience.
Skills: Strong Skills in Python, Pandas, NumPy, SQL Excellent understanding of Gen AI frameworks, Agentic AI, MCP, Evals.
Excellent knowledge in Prompt Engineering, Open-source models.
Strong skills in Langchain/LlamaIndex Experience with relevant ML frameworks including TensorFlow and PyTorch.
Hands on experience in Agentic Frameworks Ability to build optimized RAG pipelines.
Have experience with at least one substantial productionized project involving LLMs / RAG , preferably with a tangible business impact Knowledge of evals and prompt tuning.
Exposure to multi modal Gen AI use Cases. Experience in Flask/Fast API, ability to work serve and access models via APIs Containerization and MLOps.

Role Description:
1. Play a role of lead/consultant for end-to-end AI/ML/Gen AI solutions including data, technology infrastructure and models.
2. Good understanding of AI-ML machine learning life cycle management, concepts on ML algorithm, ML techniques, and operational experience.
3. Design and development of models according to the business objective, along with metrics to track their progress.
4. Optimize the models in terms of trainable parameters and operations to meet the target platform.
5. Extend existing ML libraries and frameworks to support missing layers or other features.
6. Exploring and visualizing data to gain an understanding of it, then identifying differences in data distribution that could affect performance when deploying the model in the real world
7. Verifying data quality, and/or ensuring it via data cleaning
8. Supervising the data acquisition process if more data is needed
9. Defining the pre-processing or feature engineering to be done on a given dataset
10. Defining data augmentation pipelines
11. Training models and tuning their hyper parameters
12. Analyzing the errors of the model and designing strategies to overcome them
13. Deploying models with experiment tracking.
14. Work with the technology team to plan, execute, and deliver AI/ML Product based projects. Contribute towards the best practices regarding handling the projects.
15. Provide technical design, implementation, and support services around the creation of APIs, Models and Integration Pipelines.
16. Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, including data warehouse technical architectures, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools
17. Environments Understanding of the auxiliary practical concerns in production ML systems.
18. Strong communication, presentation and consulting skills, including technical writing skills and the ability to listen and understand client issue.




Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at ritu.singh@calsoftinc.com
